A=(2x−1)(x+3)=2x2+6x−x−3=2x2+5x−3 .\begin{aligned} A & = (2x - 1)(x + 3) \\ & = 2x^2 + 6x - x - 3 \\ & = 2x^2 + 5x - 3 \,. \end{aligned}A​=(2x−1)(x+3)=2x2+6x−x−3=2x2+5x−3.​
B=(−x+3)(2x−1)=−2x2+x+6x−3=−2x2+7x−3 .\begin{aligned} B & = (-x + 3)(2x - 1) \\ & = -2x^2 + x + 6x - 3 \\ & = -2x^2 + 7x - 3 \,. \end{aligned}B​=(−x+3)(2x−1)=−2x2+x+6x−3=−2x2+7x−3.​
C=(3x+8)(x+5)=3x2+15x+8x+40=3x2+23x+40 .\begin{aligned} C & = (3x + 8)(x + 5) \\ & = 3x^2 + 15x + 8x + 40 \\ & = 3x^2 + 23x + 40 \,. \end{aligned}C​=(3x+8)(x+5)=3x2+15x+8x+40=3x2+23x+40.​
D=(x−1)(x−7)=x2−7x−x+7=x2−8x+7 .\begin{aligned} D & = (x - 1)(x - 7) \\ & = x^2 - 7x - x + 7 \\ & = x^2 - 8x + 7 \,. \end{aligned}D​=(x−1)(x−7)=x2−7x−x+7=x2−8x+7.​

E=(x2−2x+1)2=(x2−2x+1)(x2−2x+1)=x4−2x3+x2−2x3+4x2−2x+x2−2x+1=x4−4x3+6x2−4x+1 .\begin{aligned} E & = (x^2 - 2x + 1)^2 \\ & = (x^2 - 2x + 1)(x^2 - 2x + 1) \\ & = x^4 - 2x^3 + x^2 - 2x^3 + 4x^2 - 2x + x^2 - 2x + 1 \\ & = x^4 - 4x^3 + 6x^2 - 4x + 1 \,. \end{aligned}E​=(x2−2x+1)2=(x2−2x+1)(x2−2x+1)=x4−2x3+x2−2x3+4x2−2x+x2−2x+1=x4−4x3+6x2−4x+1.​

F=(2x+3)(x−1)(x2+x+1)=(2x+3)(x3+x2+x−x2−x−1)=(2x+3)(x3−1)=2x4+3x3−2x−3 .\begin{aligned} F & = (2x + 3)(x - 1)(x^2 + x + 1) \\ & = (2x + 3)(x^3 + x^2 + x - x^2 - x - 1) \\ & = (2x + 3)(x^3 - 1) \\ & = 2x^4 + 3x^3 - 2x - 3 \,. \end{aligned}F​=(2x+3)(x−1)(x2+x+1)=(2x+3)(x3+x2+x−x2−x−1)=(2x+3)(x3−1)=2x4+3x3−2x−3.​

A=2n+1−6×3n2=2n+12−6×3n2=2n−3×3n=2n−3n+1 .\begin{aligned} A & = \frac{2^{n+1} - 6 \times 3^n}{2} \\ & = \frac{2^{n+1}}{2} - \frac{6 \times 3^n}{2} \\ & = 2^n - 3 \times 3^n \\ & = 2^n - 3^{n+1} \,. \end{aligned}A​=22n+1−6×3n​=22n+1​−26×3n​=2n−3×3n=2n−3n+1.​

B=3×2n−4×2n−22n−2n−1=3×2n−22×2n−22×2n−1−2n−1=3×2n−2n2n−1=2×2n2n−1=22=4 .\begin{aligned} B & = \frac{3 \times 2^n - 4 \times 2^{n-2}}{2^n - 2^{n-1}} \\ & = \frac{3 \times 2^n - 2^2 \times 2^{n-2}}{2 \times 2^{n-1} - 2^{n-1}} \\ & = \frac{3 \times 2^n - 2^n}{2^{n-1}} \\ & = \frac{2 \times 2^n}{2^{n-1}} \\ & = 2^2 \\ & = 4 \,. \end{aligned}B​=2n−2n−13×2n−4×2n−2​=2×2n−1−2n−13×2n−22×2n−2​=2n−13×2n−2n​=2n−12×2n​=22=4.​

C=2n×8n42n=2n×(23)n(22)2n=2n×23n24n=24n−4n=20=1 .\begin{aligned} C & = \frac{2^n \times 8^n}{4^{2n}} \\ & = \frac{2^n \times (2^3)^n}{(2^2)^{2n}} \\ & = \frac{2^n \times 2^{3n}}{2^{4n}} \\ & = 2^{4n - 4n} \\ & = 2^0 \\ & = 1 \,. \end{aligned}C​=42n2n×8n​=(22)2n2n×(23)n​=24n2n×23n​=24n−4n=20=1.​

D=3n+4−6×3n+13n+2×7=3n+43n+2×7−6×3n+13n+2×7=327−2×3×3n+13n+2×7=97−2×3n+23n+2×7=97−27=1 .\begin{aligned} D & = \frac{3^{n+4} - 6 \times 3^{n+1}}{3^{n+2} \times 7} \\ & = \frac{3^{n+4}}{3^{n+2} \times 7} - \frac{6 \times 3^{n+1}}{3^{n+2} \times 7} \\ & = \frac{3^2}{7} - \frac{2 \times 3 \times 3^{n+1}}{3^{n+2} \times 7} \\ & = \frac{9}{7} - \frac{2 \times 3^{n+2}}{3^{n+2} \times 7} \\ & = \frac{9}{7} - \frac{2}{7} \\ & = 1 \,. \end{aligned}D​=3n+2×73n+4−6×3n+1​=3n+2×73n+4​−3n+2×76×3n+1​=732​−3n+2×72×3×3n+1​=79​−3n+2×72×3n+2​=79​−72​=1.​
E=22nn=(22n)1n=22nn=22=4 .\begin{aligned} E & = \sqrt[n]{2^{2n}} \\ & = (2^{2n})^{\frac{1}{n}} \\ & = 2^{\frac{2n}{n}} \\ & = 2^2 \\ & = 4 \,. \end{aligned}E​=n22n​=(22n)n1​=2n2n​=22=4.​

F=1(−1)2n+1+(−1)2n−2=1((−1)2)n×(−1)1+((−1)2)n×((−1)2)−1=11n×(−1)+1n×1−1=(−1)+1=0 .\begin{aligned} F & = \frac{1}{(-1)^{2n+1}} + (-1)^{2n-2} \\ & = \frac{1}{((-1)^2)^n \times (-1)^1} + ((-1)^2)^n \times ((-1)^2)^{-1} \\ & = \frac{1}{1^n \times (-1)} + 1^n \times 1^{-1} \\ & = (-1) + 1 \\ & = 0 \,. \end{aligned}F​=(−1)2n+11​+(−1)2n−2=((−1)2)n×(−1)11​+((−1)2)n×((−1)2)−1=1n×(−1)1​+1n×1−1=(−1)+1=0.​
